purpose: Test whether holding the average of several candidates beats picking the best one, using only information available at each decision date. Step 196 diagnosed selection as the project's central problem; this is the cheapest structural defence against it.
why_this_is_not_another_search: Every prior program searched for a better candidate. This holds the candidate set fixed and varies only the rule for choosing among them. There is nothing to tune: k is swept and reported in full, and no value of k is selected.

declared_before_running.candidates: the five saved dashboard strategies, using their published weekly net returns unchanged
declared_before_running.selection_rule_under_test: at each weekly decision, rank candidates by trailing performance using only data strictly before that date, then hold the top k equally weighted until the next decision
declared_before_running.switching_cost_rationale: Moving between books is a real portfolio turnover event, not a free relabelling. 20 bps per unit of weight changed is charged so that a rule which churns is penalised for churning.

controls.name: oracle_best
controls.rule: hold the single book with the best FULL-SAMPLE return, which cannot be known at decision time; upper bound on selection

controls.name: equal_weight_all
controls.rule: hold all five equally at all times, which is k=5 with no ranking

controls.name: random_pick
controls.rule: hold one book chosen at random each decision, 500 draws; lower bound with zero skill

hypotheses: If past performance selects future performance, k=1 beats k=5.
If the ranking is noise, k=5 beats k=1 on risk-adjusted return because averaging cancels idiosyncratic error.
If the ranking is worse than noise, k=1 underperforms the random-pick control.
not_claimed: The five candidates were themselves selected on this window, so every figure here is conditional on that. This test compares rules for combining an already-biased set; it cannot remove the bias in the set.
The overlapping histories differ in length, so results are computed on the common window only.
